name: empty-state
intent: Explain why a region is empty and offer the way out.
sequence: Distinguish the three cases: never-had-data, filtered-to-nothing, and failed-to-load
State which case this is in plain language
Offer the corresponding action — create, clear filters, or retry
While loading, show ui:skeleton rather than an empty state
requiredRules: Never show an empty state during loading
forbiddenRules: No dead-end state with no explanation
No illustration-only empty state with no text
No generic 'No data' for a case the system can distinguish
